Hello! I'm Pranit Lanjewar. I am a licensed social worker, specialized in adult mental health and trauma-informed care. Most of my professional experience involves homelessness, mental health, healthcare, community-based practice for social change, and social work academia.

I aim to pursue a Ph.D. in the near future, with a research focus on mental health and cancer. I also have many hobbies that change with the seasons, including biking, writing, walking, running, cooking, reading, gaming, socializing, and going on road trips.
